# the contributor audit: total force, exact sublevels, and deepest supporting facets

## 1. Same-separator total force

Full read of `candidate ed103e599726c87f`: PASS within its explicit same-separator and minimal-bad compactness hypotheses. the contributor reran 245 exact algebra checks.

The ordinary base-depth gap and uniform vanishing displacement give a common positive atomic gap. The common own inball then bounds every through-source coarea below, even when other fibers have supporting facets. The upper coarea bound and harmonic response normalization bound K between the stated S_min and S_max. These claims do not manufacture a joint separator; Section 4 correctly retains that as a separate hypothesis.

With w_a=kappa_a/K and sigma_a=kappa_a delta_a/Delta, both probabilities use the SAME separator. The original-volume row mixture proves K_V=-sum sigma log L_a>=0. The exact change of probability gives

    log(epsilon K/Delta)
      =KL(sigma||w)+(K_V+sum sigma log(M/E_a))/(d+1).

All terms on the right are nonnegative. Therefore Delta<=epsilon K<=epsilon S_max, and the stated scaled entropy bounds follow from t exp(-t)<=1/e. They are volume entropy statements and do not bound a surface logarithmic term. The one-interval calibration has the right covariance normalization and attains equality; it makes no bad-minimum claim.

## 2. Exact left-quantile obstacle

Full read of `candidate b12ff19e04f5fad1`: PASS. the contributor previously reran 120,489 exact calibrations; Two-sided's independent written audit also passes.

Fixed-source status clamping preserves each proper scalar and the full/empty masses, and bounds the replacement base tilt using a finite fixed-matrix active-set argument. Thus it gives actual cap and signed-radius attainment, including a tail plateau. The left endpoint is essential for the closed sublevel relation. Its finite domain is exactly baseDepth>Q; equality belongs to the infinite domain. The perspective formula for the obstacle has the correct monotonicities, and positive parameter values are explicitly required where the signed radius is replaced by its positive part. Boundary energy zero is treated by a genuine ambient supporting cap of zero mixed volume.

This is an exact reformulation, not a finite witness theorem or an OC payment.

## 3. A unique deepest mark need not admit inside-free critical caps

Full read of `candidate 79b44436a463e3c4` and its checker: PASS. the contributor reran 1,529 exact checks. Slab independently verified the certificate by 16,346 exact checks, including triangle containment, pairwise interior separation, total area and all Bernstein signs; see its separate audit.

The analytic coverage argument and exact finite certificate cover the entire two normal simplices. Strictness away from the axes, the complete axis breakpoints and their tails, and the pure-base comparisons exhaust all ambient normals. Strict loss of energy off the own centroid makes the actual global deepest point unique. Its only two minimizing cap rays both have an inside supporting facet. The normalized depth is above the OC target, and no joint parameter/body minimum is asserted.

## 4. Centroid balance blocks one attempted strengthening

Full read of `candidate 58f3f048f8ef3f61`: PASS. the contributor reran 38 exact checks. In its stated five-rectangle pattern, local tilt minimality requires r_-1>=r_1. A finite opposite steep cap has the exact difference

    R-Q=B-b(r_-1-r_1)-delta(r_-1+r_1).

At B=0 and delta>0 this is negative. At delta=0, global minimality instead forces equal middle widths and allows a nearby inside-free cap of the same mass. The specific adjusted body's deficit is exactly 2407/800000. Thus the original globally deepest example remains valid, but this modification cannot add a one-row constant-weight centroid certificate.

None of these results supplies the missing sharp body argument. Full OC remains unproved.
